_about: One evidence set for the robots.txt grammar in TWO languages (plan 82 D82-4). lib/agent-readiness/robots-agents.ts is tested against every case here by robots-agents.test.ts; the WordPress plugin's PHP port (RankXAI_Robots) is tested against a byte-identical copy in its probe/fixtures/ by probe/verify-crawler-report.mjs. Copy with scripts/sync-plugin-fixtures.mjs; never edit the plugin's copy.

crawlers.consequence: ChatGPT cannot include your pages in its search results.
ChatGPT cannot open your pages when a user asks it to.
OpenAI cannot use your pages to learn what your business is.
Claude cannot include your pages in its search results.
Claude cannot open your pages when a user asks it to.
Anthropic cannot use your pages to learn what your business is.
Perplexity cannot index your pages, so it cannot cite you.
Perplexity cannot open your pages when a user asks it to.
Google cannot use your pages to ground Gemini or AI Overviews.
Apple cannot use your pages for its AI features.
Meta cannot use your pages to learn what your business is.
Alexa cannot surface your pages in answers.
ByteDance cannot use your pages for its AI features.
Common Crawl cannot archive your pages, which most open models learn from.

unmappedRegistryIds.googlebot: a search engine; robots.txt addresses it as Googlebot, which is not an AI crawler token
unmappedRegistryIds.bingbot: a search engine, not an AI crawler token
unmappedRegistryIds.applebot: a search engine; Apple's AI opt-out is the separate Applebot-Extended token
unmappedRegistryIds.duckassistbot: fetches on a person's behalf; DuckDuckGo documents no robots.txt token for it
unmappedRegistryIds.mistralai-user: fetches on a person's behalf; Mistral documents no robots.txt token for it

parse.name: consecutive User-agent lines share ONE group
a rule line closes the agent run
parse.robots:
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /
User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /admin

parse.name: a BOM does not swallow the first group
comments are stripped, including trailing ones
parse.robots:
# a comment line
User-agent: GPTBot # the OpenAI crawler
Disallow: / # everything

parse.name: a line with no colon is counted as unparsed
parse.robots:
User-agent: *
this is not a directive
Disallow: /x

parse.name: an empty file has no groups

patterns.name: a bare prefix matches by prefix
a bare prefix does not match elsewhere
an empty Disallow never matches the root
an empty Disallow never matches anything
* is still anchored to its tail
an unbalanced bracket is literal, never a block

access.name: consecutive agents: the first is blocked
consecutive agents: the second is blocked too
separate groups: GPTBot blocked
access.robots:
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /
User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /admin

access.name: separate groups: ClaudeBot allowed at the root
access.robots:
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /
User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /admin

access.name: separate groups: ClaudeBot blocked on its own path
access.robots:
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /
User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /admin

access.name: an exact agent match beats *
* governs an agent not named
the longest pattern wins (disallow)
the longest pattern wins (allow)
on an equal-length tie, Allow beats Disallow
groups naming the same agent are merged (root)
access.robots:
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /blog
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

access.name: groups naming the same agent are merged (blog)
access.robots:
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /blog
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

access.name: agent matching is case-insensitive
no group at all means unaddressed, never blocked
a group with no matching rule means allowed, and names the group
a blocked verdict carries the rule that produced it
an empty file leaves a crawler unaddressed

access.name: a specific Allow survives a * blanket disallow
and the others are still blocked by *
a stray rule before any User-agent is attributed to *

every.name: a blanket disallow blocks every AI crawler through *
an empty robots.txt leaves every crawler unaddressed
a file naming only Googlebot leaves the AI crawlers unaddressed

blanket.name: a BOM-prefixed blanket disallow is still a blanket
a stray rule before any User-agent is a blanket
* disallowing one path is not a blanket
an empty Disallow is not a blanket
an empty file is not a blanket
